| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Burst Knock | `burstKnockEnabled` | choice |  | Pull ignition timing while the TPS acceleration-enrichment threshold is exceeded, then decay the retard to zero. This uses the TPS delta and lookback, not acoustic knock detection. |
| Decay Time | `burstKnockDecayTime` | s | 0 … 10 | Linear decay time measured from the last above-threshold TPS sample. Zero removes retard as soon as the transient ends. |
